notes: The Hearth Chest on the Great Hearth's ledge (the Burning Tower, Tyler 2026-11-14; redrawn lane/a-tower-art-gen 2026-11-16). One generated great iron-bound oak chest, curved lid, four locks on its front band laid by tools/world-art/tower-art.mjs in each key's soot-dulled metal (LOCKS: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum; lane/fix137-hearth-chest-art 2026-11-17, Tyler: the bright plates read as candy dots), as the locked story has it: 'one big chest on the ledge, with a different lock for the better ones'. Its open state (the same chest, lid up on a bed of embers) is the Tower window's reveal only. Its 8-frame idle is the Hearth fire's light on the iron facing the fire and a glint passing over its locks (tower-art.mjs FLICKER, glintsAt), so the ambient row loops on the town's clock. Placed by the town map's AMBIENT row against the stone pier right of the firebox (src/data/world/town/sites.js), with its manifest ellipse drawn under it on the ledge (compose.js ambient shade), and drawn only while the server sends the Tower's section.
